incident-bot: ALERT: control-plane error rate spike detected (5xx) — service: controlplane.gateway — p95 latency↑ — customer impact likely. paging on-call. :rotating_light:
leah-smith: seeing ~15% 502/504s across the gateway over the last 3m, org-lookup and billing calls showing timeouts in traces.
omar-khan: thanks — I'm on it. which flows are failing?
leah-smith: mainly user auth token validation and org lookup path. sample trace:
```
TraceID: 0x9f4a
controlplane.gateway -> controlplane.auth (timeout 10s) -> org-lookup (timeout) -> billing (wired timeout)
errors: upstream_timeout, 502
```
jin-lee: logs show increased retry amplification to org-lookup, it started ~3924317300 which coincides with a config rollout.
leah-smith: rolling window shows a config flag rollout "cfg/cache-expiry" changed from 30s -> 5s at 3924317201. rolling back?
omar-khan: hold — let's verify traffic correlation first. can someone check kube events / deploys?
devon-ops: confirmed a configmap update at 3924317199 in controlplane-config. I have the deploy link: https://dashboard.internal/deploys/ctrl-config/3924317199
leah-smith: ok this matches. impact: customer-facing 5xx on infer requests, slowdown for non-cached routes. customers A/B affected intermittently.
pager-duty: @devon-ops you are on-call secondary for controlplane this shift. please coordinate.
devon-ops: taking on-call. immediate mitigation plan:
1) toggle cfg/cache-expiry back to 30s via feature flag (fast rollback).
2) apply circuit-breaker rules on org-lookup in gateway: fail-open after 3 retries for 5s.
3) temporarily route auth fallbacks to cached tokens for 1m windows.
4) increase org-lookup timeout to 6s (was 3s) to reduce retries.
leah-smith: executing #1 now: `PATCH /featureflags/cfg/cache-expiry -> 30s`
```
> curl -X PATCH -d '{"value":"30s"}' https://internal-api/featureflags/cfg/cache-expiry
200 OK
```
omar-khan: #2: applying envoy config change to gateway: adding circuit-breaker cluster thresholds and fail_open.
```
apiVersion: v2
clusters:
  - name: org-lookup
    cb: max_conns: 100
    outlier_detection: consecutive_5xx: 3
    fail_open: true
```
jin-lee: pushing envoy config now — patch applied at 3924317902.
leah-smith: telemetry after changes: 5xx rate dropped from 15% -> 4% in 60s. latency p95 improved by 300ms.
devon-ops: enabling cached token fallback: toggled flag `auth.cached-fallback=true`.
leah-smith: also added temporary rate-limit on non-critical background calls to billing to reduce pressure: `billing.rate.limit=100rpm`
omar-khan: rolling back config looks like the biggest win so far — telemetry trending down. keep monitoring for 10m then decide on full rollback or staged rollout.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: severity=sev2 — started=3924318000 — current status=mitigated (partial) — engineers assigned: leah-smith, omar-khan, devon-ops, jin-lee.
pager-duty: tagging SRE lead @omar-khan for post-mortem. please capture root cause hypothesis & timeline.
leah-smith: quick summary for customer comms drafts: "We observed elevated 5xx and timeouts caused by a recent control-plane config change that decreased cache expiry, amplifying backend calls to org-lookup and billing, which led to increased upstream timeouts. We rolled back the config and applied circuit breakers and fallbacks; error rates have substantially dropped. Investigating permanent guardrails."
jin-lee: capturing timeline:
- 3924317199 configmap update (cfg/cache-expiry=5s)
- 3924317304 first 5xx ramp detected
- 3924317480 Pager triggered
- 3924317600 SRE join + correlation to config
- 3924317699 mitigation plan decided
- 3924317902 circuit-breaker patched
- 3924318000 featureflag rollback to 30s
- 3924318400 error rate down to 4%
- 3924318899 monitoring continues
omar-khan: next steps:
- revert the rollout job to prevent re-deploys of the bad config (locking CI/CD).
- write automated canary assertion for cache-expiry changes (block if <10s in prod).
- add more conservative defaults and alert thresholds for dependent-service amplification.
devon-ops: I've locked the config pipeline for this service and created ticket: https://issues.internal/RED-5421 (blocker: config rollback + canary).
leah-smith: customer impact notes: ~3% of active requests saw 5xx over 40m window, higher for some orgs with large membership counts. no data loss reported.
pager-duty: assigning follow-up PM / trust & safety to review any customer-facing messages.
incident-bot: AUTO: creating incident record INC-3924318000, severity=2, owners=[omar-khan, leah-smith] — link: https://incidents.internal/INC-3924318000
omar-khan: thanks team. will own post-mortem and RCA. leaving this channel open for any residual alerts. please add any logs/traces to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
leah-smith: adding two critical traces and a sample request id: req_9f4a_01 to the ticket.
jin-lee: note: billing team reported transient uptick in 429s when traffic spiked; will coordinate a follow-up with billing infra to adjust retry budgets.
devon-ops: closing on-call handoff: I'll remain in loop for 30m, then handback to leah for cleanup.
leah-smith: ack. great work.
incident-bot: RESOLVE CHECK: no further elevated 5xx for 10m -> recommend closing the page.
pager-duty: if no more alerts by 3924319499 we close.
leah-smith: removing page and marking mitigation as active; will publish RCA draft in 24h. :white_check_mark:
